evals.prompt: Reframe this weak card, id c-1234abcd, front: 'In cadre-runner, what callback does engine_seam.tick_pass now take to start a dialogue turn, and what are its four arguments?' Context: the engine takes a start_turn callback so engine_seam never imports the runner module.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites it as a why/what-breaks concept or code card with a reference, using cards revise, keeping the id.
expectations: The new front asks why/what-depends/what-breaks rather than listing arguments
The JSON includes a kind and a reference with an answer and at least one point
Shows the old and new wording

evals.prompt: Propose cards for a sourdough lesson the driver just finished on when a levain is ready (peaked and just starting to fall), the float test's unreliability, and why a young levain gives a milder loaf.
evals.expected_output: One to three cards with kinds and references, source named 'sourdough', not a path.
expectations: Between one and three cards are proposed
Every card has kind and reference.answer and reference.points
--source is a topic name (e.g. sourdough), not a filesystem path
At least one card is a concept card asking why

evals.prompt: We just finished a task that renamed a CSS variable --accent to --cadre-accent across 40 files. Propose cards on it.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: little worth remembering; proposes at most one card or none, explaining why.
expectations: Explains that a mechanical rename has little to retain, or picks the one non-obvious point
Does not propose a card asking for the old or new variable name alone
